title: Drug Testing
one_paragraph_synopsis: Dwight initiates a drug investigation after finding a joint and discussing symptoms of marijuana use. The office experiences a shift as Michael cancels formal drug testing in favor of visual inspections, while Dwight resists giving a urine sample for a drug test. The episode explores office suspicions, Dwight's resistance, and Michael's anti-drug stance, culminating in Dwight passing a drug test and resigning his security uniform.

main_threads.thread: Office's response to drug testing and Michael's actions

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, attention everyone the drug testing has been cancelled. Instead, I will be going around to each of you and doing a visual inspection.
Dwight: No you can't do that.
Michael: I can do that, it is my office.
Dwight: Kevin, what prescription drugs are you taking, besides Rogaine?
Kevin: I'm not taking Rogaine.
Michael: Drugs ruin lives people. Drugs destroy careers.
